title: Euclid × CMB Lensing
author: Cail Daley & Euclid CMBX team
description: Status update on Euclid × ACT/SPT CMB lensing cross-correlations
footer: Cail Daley · Euclid × CMB-κ · SPT Secondaries & Cross-Correlations · March 30, 2026

sections.title: Status
sections.outline: Euclid DR1 is coming on a hard schedule, and the Paris CMBX group is building the cross-correlation pipeline for it.

sections.title: RR2 data
sections.outline: The unblinded RR2 release overlaps ACT DR6 and SPT-3G, with six tomographic bins for each tracer.

sections.title: Cross-spectra
sections.outline: Galaxy density, cosmic shear and tSZ cross-spectra from RR2, and a check of the map estimator against the catalogue estimator.

sections.title: Systematics
sections.outline: Eleven systematic maps, and the contamination they could imprint on each galaxy–CMB-lensing cross-spectrum.

sections.title: Scale dependence
sections.outline: How the fitted lensing amplitude in each bin changes with the maximum multipole used.
